protocol.status: post-hoc held-out diagnostic on Computer QA
protocol.router: frozen DistilBERT, 8 soft tokens, two correctness heads, inverse-cost weighted BCE

questions.scaling: D gold disagreements + 25 gold agreements, D in [5, 15, 25] (pool holds ~24-26 disagreements, so D=25 is exhaustion); random controls at matched totals
questions.augment: d25_a25 gold base + N unlabeled agreement rows with consistency loss (q_nano - q_mini)^2, weight 1.0, N in [50, 'all']

protocol.augment_labels: gold of augmented rows never used; agreement bit is observable from cached preds
protocol.reuse: random50 from computer_qa_prior_mo_random.json; d25_a25 from computer_qa_active_selection.json (disagree_oracle; identical salt and training path)
